home.hero.headline:
Where dogs
and data meet.
home.hero.lede: DogMetrics builds Insight — a breeding-data platform that gathers every dog in a club's registry and turns pedigrees, health results and trial scores into decisions breeders actually use.

home.clients.head: Trusted by Swedish breed clubs
home.intro.title:
One registry.
Every dog. Every result.
home.intro.p1: For most clubs, the data is there — but scattered across SKK exports, trial protocols, health registries and a decade of spreadsheets. Insight gathers it all, links it to pedigree, and puts it in front of the people making breeding decisions.
home.intro.p2: Breeders use it to find matching sires for their dam with one click. Breeding committees use it to spot narrowing gene pools before they become a problem. Boards use it to see their breed clearly — by the numbers, not by memory.
home.intro.p3: It's fast, searchable, and built by people who know that a pedigree is not a spreadsheet.
home.features.title:
Six capabilities.
Built for clubs that take breeding seriously.
home.f1.title: Full pedigree graph
home.f1.body: Every dog in the club, linked up and down the ancestry tree. Walk five generations in either direction — with health, trial and show results attached to each node.
home.f1.label: Generations
home.f2.title: Find matching dogs
home.f2.body: Select your sire or dam and Insight ranks compatible partners by coefficient of inbreeding, health scores, trial results and temperament. Filter on the dimensions you care about.
home.f2.label: Candidates ranked
home.f3.title: Breed-wide statistics
home.f3.body: Track inbreeding trends, HD/ED distributions, registration counts and trial outcomes across the whole breed. See what's improving and what's drifting.
home.f3.label: Indicators
home.f4.title: Sire & dam lists
home.f4.body: The same parnings- och avelslistor your breeding committee already maintains — now live, searchable, and updated by owners themselves.
home.f4.label: Self-service
home.f5.title: Field & show results
home.f5.body: Every jaktprov, utställning and working-test result attached to each dog — pulled in from SKK and club-run events. No more hunting through PDFs.
home.f5.label: Protocols parsed
home.f6.title: Health programme
home.f6.body: HD, ED, eyes, heart — every SKK health result mapped to the dog and visible in pedigree context. Spot patterns before they concentrate.
home.f6.label: SKK-synced
home.case.title:
Svenska Vorstehklubben,
since 2024.
home.case.lede: SVK — one of Sweden's oldest special clubs, founded 1917 — moved their mating & breeding lists and the full breed registry to Insight. Seven continental pointing breeds. About 2,400 members. One source of truth.
home.case.quote: Insight gave our breeding committee something we never had — the full picture, in one place, fast enough to actually use in conversation.
home.team.title: A small team with field dogs under the desk.
home.team.body: Two people, split between Burträsk in the north and Göteborg on the west coast, who grew up around breeding clubs and spent the last decade building data infrastructure for everything except dogs. We fixed that.

product.title: Product · Insight — DogMetrics
product.headline:
Every dog in your club,
every number that matters,
in one view.
product.lede: Insight is the breeding-data platform for special and breed clubs. Pedigree, health, trial results and mating lists — pulled together, linked up, and put in front of the people who actually make breeding decisions.
product.s1.title: The full graph, walkable.
product.s1.lede: Click any dog, walk five generations in either direction. Every ancestor is linked to its own page — with its health, its results, its offspring, and the dogs its offspring produced.
product.s1.f1: 5+ generation tree with live health & trial overlays on each node.
product.s1.f2: Inbreeding coefficient recalculated in-browser as you explore hypothetical matings.
product.s1.f3: Line-breeding view highlights common ancestors across sire and dam.
product.s1.f4: Cross-breed lookup because SVK manages seven breeds that share bloodlines.
product.s2.title:
Find your match,
by the numbers.
product.s2.lede: Select your dam. Insight pulls every eligible sire in the registry and ranks them on the dimensions you weight — inbreeding, HD/ED, trial scores, temperament, geography.
product.s2.f1: Weighted ranking configurable per breed by the breeding committee.
product.s2.f2: Hypothetical COI before you pick up the phone — no surprises on paper.
product.s2.f4: Shortlist & share with the owner, or export as PDF for the committee.
product.s3.title:
The breed,
as a system.
product.s3.lede: Zoom out to the whole breed. Track genetic diversity, registration trends, health outcomes and working results year over year. Catch drift before it becomes a problem.
product.s3.f1: Inbreeding trend for the whole population over any time window.
product.s3.f2: Effective population size — the Ne number breeding committees actually care about.
product.s3.f3: HD/ED distributions by sire, by cohort, by year.
product.s3.f4: Trial-result analytics — field vs. show vs. working, normalised.
product.s4.title:
Mating & breeding lists,
finally live.
product.s4.lede: The same lists your breeding committee has always maintained — now owned by the owners themselves, reviewed by the committee, always current. No more email threads, no more "send me the latest PDF."
product.s4.f2: Always current — no versioned spreadsheets, no stale PDFs.
product.s4.f3: Searchable by health status, region, trial merits.
product.s4.f4: Audit log of every change, for committee accountability.
product.s5.title:
Every result,
attached to the dog.
product.s5.lede: Field trials, shows, working tests, Riksprovet — every result the club runs (and every result SKK holds) flows into each dog's page. No hunting through PDFs, no losing track of what Hedda did in UKL last autumn.
product.s5.f1: SKK sync for show and official trial results.
product.s5.f2: Club-run protocols digitised at source — judges enter directly.
product.s5.f3: Result-weighted matching feeds back into sire/dam ranking.
product.s5.f4: PDF import for legacy protocols, OCR'd and linked.
product.s6.title:
The SKK health programme,
in pedigree context.
product.s6.lede: Every HD, ED, eye and heart result mapped to the right dog and visible where it matters — inside the pedigree view, inside matching, inside breed statistics. Breeding committees spot concentration risks before they become breed-wide.
product.s6.f1: Daily SKK sync so the registry is never more than 24 hours out of date.
product.s6.f3: Ancestor overlays show carrier risk through the line.
product.s7.title:
Fits the ecosystem
you already run on.
product.s7.lede: Insight doesn't replace SKK — it builds on it. We sync with the registry you already trust, and plug into the tools your committee already uses.

clubs.title: For breed clubs — DogMetrics
clubs.headline:
Built for the way
breed clubs actually work.
clubs.lede: Special clubs under SKK manage real breeding — committees, health programmes, working tests, dozens of trials a year. Insight meets that reality.
clubs.who.title:
Three jobs,
one platform.
clubs.who1.title: The board
clubs.who1.body: See the breed clearly. Registration trends, genetic diversity, where the club is drifting and where it's holding. Evidence for every annual report, in one dashboard.
clubs.who2.title: The breeding committee
clubs.who2.body: The mating & breeding lists you already maintain — now self-service for owners, audited, always current. Spend meetings on edge cases, not spreadsheet upkeep.
clubs.who3.title: The breeders & owners
clubs.who3.body: Find matching partners for your dog in one click. See every relative's health and trial record. Enter your dog on the availability list yourself.
clubs.how.title:
Six weeks from
kickoff to live.
clubs.w1b: 30 minutes with your breeding committee. We map what you have — SKK exports, trial protocols, legacy PDFs, current tools — and what you want next.
clubs.w2b: We pull your pedigree, health and results data into a staging environment. Your committee reviews it for anomalies. Nothing goes live yet.
clubs.w3b: Two sessions, two hours each. Your committee learns the admin side. Owner-facing interfaces need no training — they just work.
clubs.w4b: A subset of members — usually the breeding committee plus 20 active breeders — use Insight for real. We fix edge cases live.
clubs.w5b: Public launch, embedded into your existing club website. SKK sync runs nightly from day one.
clubs.svk.title: Svenska Vorstehklubben.
clubs.svk.deck: SVK has been breeding Continental pointing dogs for over a century — founded 1917, seven breeds, about 2,400 members, ten regional chapters. The breeding committee maintains the mating & breeding lists the whole Swedish vorsteh community uses to find partners for their dogs.
clubs.svk.challenge_body: Fourteen years of mating lists spread across spreadsheets, Word documents and a legacy ASP site. Trial results in PDFs on ten different servers. SKK health data re-keyed by hand every quarter. The committee spent more time maintaining data than analysing it.
clubs.svk.approach_body: We migrated the entire mating & breeding list structure, linked it to full SKK pedigree data, and gave owners a self-service interface to keep their own entries current. The breeding committee now reviews, not re-enters.
clubs.svk.outcome_body: Six weeks from kickoff to production. 2,471 dogs in the registry on day one. Committee meeting time reclaimed for actual breeding decisions instead of admin.
clubs.pricing.title:
Priced for breed clubs,
not enterprise SaaS.
clubs.pricing.body: Insight is a yearly subscription based on membership count. No per-seat fees, no per-feature upsells. Setup and migration are included for the first installation in any breed group.

about.title: About — DogMetrics
about.headline:
A small team,
building the tools
we wished existed.
about.lede: DogMetrics was founded in 2024 by two people based between Burträsk (Västerbotten) and Göteborg, who grew up around Swedish breeding clubs — and spent the previous decade building data infrastructure everywhere except in the one place they cared about most.
about.story.title: Pedigrees aren't spreadsheets.
about.story.p1: Every serious breeder knows this in their hands. A pedigree is a graph — a living thing, updated with every litter, every test, every trial. But the tools most clubs run on treat it like a list.
about.story.p2: We kept hearing the same thing from breeding committees across Sweden: the data is there, technically. SKK holds it. The club holds some. The breeders hold the rest. But nobody can see it all at once — and by the time you've pulled it together for one pairing, the answer is already outdated.
about.story.p3: So we built Insight. One registry. Every dog. Every result. Fast enough to use mid-conversation with a breeder on the phone.
about.team.title:
Two people,
one shared obsession.
about.t1.name: Anna Nylander
about.t1.bio: Grew up around breeding clubs in Västerbotten and spent the last decade building data platforms. Anchors the northern end of the company from Burträsk.
about.t2.name: Jonas Peterson
about.t2.bio: Software engineer based in Göteborg, with a background in large-scale data infrastructure. Handles product and delivery from the west coast.
about.values.title: Three things we hold to.
about.v1.title: SKK is the source
about.v1.body: We don't compete with Svenska Kennelklubben's registry. We build on it. Every dog in Insight is the same dog SKK has on file — same number, same pedigree.
about.v2.title: Breeders know their breed
about.v2.body: We don't tell breeding committees how to breed. We give them the full picture and trust their judgement. The tool bends to the club, not the other way round.
about.v3.title: Quiet software
about.v3.body: No notifications. No engagement metrics. No gamification. Insight is a reference tool — you reach for it when you need it, it gets out of the way when you don't.
about.contact.title: Talk to us.
about.contact.body: We're a small team and we answer our own email. hello@dogmetrics.se — or use the demo form on the home page.
